LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blood.nodes.0.label: Blood Pact
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blood.nodes.0.description: Retains the chosen Blood evolution. Refinement: overheal-to-shield conversion or kill healing. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10; shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blood.nodes.1.label: Drink from the Blade
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blood.nodes.1.description: While you have treatable injuries, three ordinary hits heal up to 20 non-permanent injury points on you. Cooldown: 3 seconds. A gap of 4 seconds between eligible hits resets progress. Full health, permanent scars alone and bonus damage do not build progress. Refinement: healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blood.nodes.2.label: Share the Blood
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blood.nodes.2.description: An ordinary hit heals up to 20 non-permanent injury points on the other allied colonist with the most treatable injury severity within 4 cells. Cooldown: 4 seconds. Ties prefer the nearer ally. Scars are excluded; no eligible patient means no cooldown. Refinement: healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blood.nodes.3.label: Wetted Edge
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blood.nodes.3.description: Real healing from Drink from the Blade prepares one 3-second opportunity: your next ordinary hit deals 50 extra damage. It neither stacks nor refreshes, and the hit that healed you cannot consume it. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blood.nodes.4.label: Held Blood
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blood.nodes.4.description: Real healing from Drink from the Blade stores one charge for 4 seconds, capped at one; further healing does not refresh it. Casting your Blood ability spends it for a 2-point self shield lasting 3 seconds. Healing attempts without recovery store nothing. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blood.nodes.5.label: Keep the Pulse
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blood.nodes.5.description: After Share the Blood actually heals, remember that patient for 3 seconds. Your next ordinary hit on a different enemy grants the patient a 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per healing event. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blood.nodes.6.label: Stay Close
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blood.nodes.6.description: After Share the Blood heals, walk at least two native steps and land an ordinary hit while within 2 cells of that patient to heal up to 20 more non-permanent injury point. The window lasts 3 seconds; teleporting does not count, and full health preserves only the original window. Refinement: healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blood.nodes.7.label: Blood Trace
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blood.nodes.7.description: A real Wetted Edge hit leaves a 4-second blood trace on up to two enemies. Your Blood ability hit consumes it for 75 extra damage, at most once per second per victim. Refinement: trace bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blood.nodes.8.label: Returning Tide
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blood.nodes.8.description: When a Held Blood shield absorbs enemy damage, remember the latest attacker for 3 seconds. A close ordinary hit within 2 cells deals 50 extra damage once per shield round. Later blocks do not extend the window. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blood.nodes.9.label: Give Back
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blood.nodes.9.description: After a Keep the Pulse shield absorbs enemy damage, your next ordinary hit within 3 seconds heals up to 20 injury points on another injured ally within 4 cells, excluding that shield’s patient. Once per shield round; without another patient, only the original window remains. Refinement: healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blood.nodes.10.label: Hold the Wound
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blood.nodes.10.description: If a patient remains below 50% native total health after Stay Close’s follow-up actually heals, grant them a 50-point shield for 3 seconds. Once per follow-up; check health after healing. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blood.nodes.11.label: Change Blades
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blood.nodes.11.description: After your Blood ability consumes a trace and deals real bonus damage, an ordinary hit on a different enemy within 3 seconds heals you for up to 20 injury points. One opportunity per cast, without repeated renewal. Refinement: healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blood.nodes.12.label: Reclaim Blood
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blood.nodes.12.description: Real Blood Trace damage heals you for up to 20 non-permanent injury points. If healing occurs, also grant a 25-point shield for 3 seconds. Once per ability cast. Refinement: healing and shield strength. Full health grants no healing. Base rewards: shield 25; healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10; shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blood.nodes.13.label: Step into the Tide
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blood.nodes.13.description: After Returning Tide deals real damage, remember your position for 3 seconds. Walk at least two steps and move 2 cells away, then land a close ordinary hit on another enemy for 50 extra damage, once per return. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blood.nodes.14.label: Lingering Warmth
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blood.nodes.14.description: After Returning Tide deals real damage, grant a 50-point shield for 3 seconds to the nearest other allied colonist within 4 cells. If none is nearby, heal yourself for up to 20 non-permanent injury points. No delayed payout is stored. Refinement: healing and shield strength. Full health grants no healing. Base rewards: shield 50; healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10; shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blood.nodes.15.label: The Pulse Returns
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blood.nodes.15.description: After Give Back actually heals a different ally, grant the original Keep the Pulse patient a 50-point shield for 3 seconds. This new shield cannot restart Give Back. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blood.nodes.16.label: Move Together
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blood.nodes.16.description: After Give Back heals, remember the new patient’s position for 3 seconds. Walk within 2 cells of it and land an ordinary hit to grant you and that patient separate 25-point shields for 3 seconds, once per Give Back. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 25. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blood.nodes.17.label: Hold On
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blood.nodes.17.description: When Hold the Wound’s shield actually absorbs enemy damage, your next ordinary hit within 2 cells may heal its patient for up to 20 non-permanent injury points. Once within 3 seconds; later blocks do not extend the window. Refinement: healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blood.nodes.18.label: Relieve the Guard
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blood.nodes.18.description: After Hold the Wound grants its shield, remember the patient’s position for 3 seconds. Walk outside its 2-cell radius and land a close hit on a different enemy to heal another injured ally within 4 cells for up to 20 injury points, excluding the original patient. Once per round. Refinement: healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.
